wef_skill_ai_bigdata.text: 'AI and big data' is the fastest-growing skill in employers' outlook to 2030.

wef_skill_cyber.text: 'Networks and cybersecurity' is the second fastest-growing skill.

wef_skill_techlit.text: 'Technological literacy' is the third fastest-growing skill.

wef_skill_creative.text: 'Creative thinking' is expected to keep rising in importance.

wef_skill_curiosity.text: 'Curiosity and lifelong learning' and 'Resilience, flexibility and agility' are expected to keep rising in importance.

wef_skill_leadership.text: 'Leadership and social influence' is among the skills growing in importance.

wef_skill_analytical.text: 'Analytical thinking' remains the most sought-after core skill among employers.

wef_skill_env.text: 'Environmental stewardship' is among the skills growing in importance.

wef_role_devops.text: 'DevOps Engineers' are among the fastest-growing jobs.

wef_role_uiux.text: 'UI and UX Designers' are among the fastest-growing jobs.
